---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
attacks <- read_csv("data/attacks_clean.csv") |>
  mutate(
    # Trim whitespace and lowercase country names so they match map data
    Country_lower = str_to_lower(str_trim(Country)),
    # Group Y and N cleanly and lump missing/messy codes into Unknown
    Fatal_clean = case_when(
      Fatal == "Y" ~ "Fatal",
      Fatal == "N" ~ "Non-fatal",
      .default = "Unknown"
    )
  )

write_rds(attacks, "data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
# Count recorded shark attacks per country
country_counts <- attacks |>
  filter(!is.na(Country_lower)) |>
  count(Country_lower, name = "attacks")

# Join counts onto world map polygon coordinates
map_data("world") |>
  mutate(Country_lower = str_to_lower(region)) |>
  left_join(country_counts, by = "Country_lower") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = attacks)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  coord_quickmap()
```
